sources.title: Model Configurations | xiaomi-research/colar | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document describes the YAML-based model configuration system in CoLaR, which defines how different model variants (CoLaR, Coconut, CoT, Distill, ICoT) are configured for training and inference. These configurations control model architecture, training parameters, and specialized components for compressed latent reasoning.
